draft.body:
Dear Master,

The office has seen the new ECMWF IFS forecast run of 22 Jan 00z. Heavy weather along your remaining route to Rotterdam starts immediately from 22 Jan 0800 UTC, with the strongest wind Beaufort 8 and highest seas 6.7 m on 26–27 Jan.

The weather routing service's advice and your own judgement come first, and the office supports whatever you decide.

Please advise if the ETA changes.

Best wishes for ship and crew.
